name: 陳明彥
objective:
先修課程: 4401051 或負責教授同意
This course introduces the fundamental Engineering drawing from mechanical parts to assembly drawings. The software, AutoCAD, is employed to develop the CAD drawing skills.
schedule:
Week 1: Course introduction, AutoCAD environment
Week 2: Plane drawing, drawing frame
Week 3: Projection, 3-view drawing
Week 4: Sectional view
Week 5: Dimensioning
Week 6: Tolerance
Week 7: Clearance/ Inteference
Week 8: Surface treatment
Week 9: Screw
Week 10: Bearing / Chamfer / Round
Week 11: Assembly
Week 12: Assembly
Week 13: Assembly
Week 14: 3D drawing
Week 15: 3D drawing
Week 16: 3D drawing
Week 17: Flexible Learning
Week 18: Flexible Learning
scorePolicy:
In-class assignments 80%
Group discussion record 5%
Group complete report 15%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】



1. Engineering drawing and design, 6th edition, David Madison, 2016
2. Interpreting Engineering Drawing, 8th edition, Theodore J. Branoff, 2014
3. Textbook of Engineering Drawing, 2nd edition, K. Venkata Reddy, 2008
4. 最新 CNS 工程圖學，三版，陳朝光、賴元隆,、黃維富，2024
